verdict.rationale: uv documents a concrete migration path for pip users: `uv add -r` imports every dependency from an existing requirements.txt into the project. Its drop-in `uv pip` interface also lets pip and pip-tools projects switch without restructuring, and community reports describe smooth switches with some friction (e.g., no `--user` install). Although uv claims to replace poetry and other tools, the pack shows no conversion tooling for their project files or lockfiles. missing for 10: documented importers for poetry/pipenv/conda projects and lockfiles, a dedicated end-to-end migration guide, independent hands-on corroboration of the requirements.txt import.
